{{Quote|We have located the enemy's shield generator facility, but were unable to approach. It is heavily guarded.|Hemdil Tre|<ref name="Fallen Empire">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>}}
After the end of their [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] around [[3636 BBY]], the [[Eternal Empire]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]] built a '''shield bunker''' atop the [[Ternion Building]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to support the [[Nar Shaddaa Star Fortress|Star Fortress]] that they placed in geosynchronous orbit above the bunker.<ref name="Resistance" /> Commanded by [[ZG-841F]], an elite [[Skytrooper]], the bunker and its [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] was protected by powerful defensive emplacements, [[Walker/Legends|walkers]], and [[Eternal Empire trooper]]s.<ref name="Destroy" /> Around [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Date2" /> [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]]&mdash;leader of an [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against Zakuul&mdash;rallied the local resistance against the Eternal Empire<ref name="Resistance" /> and organized a bombardment of the bunker, allowing the Outlander and the former [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Veeroa Denz]] to infiltrate and destroy the bunker and thus expose the [[Star Fortress]].<ref name="Destroy" />

==Behind the scenes==
The shield bunker on Nar Shaddaa was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], a 2015 Digital Expansion.
